worldcombat.skill.hardpress.summary: Raise an arm or claw and press the foe into the ground from above: attack and weight set the force, and the more HP the target still has, the heavier the press - a wounded target takes far less. It is the fastest and cheapest of the three pressing moves, meant to be laid down again and again; the two-arm form covers several foes standing together but hits each one lighter.
Hard Press deals %1$s Steel contact damage; the more HP the target still has, the heavier the press.
The press covers a %1$s block radius, sinks the target %2$s blocks and shoves it %3$s blocks away.
You can reach up to %1$s blocks; the press throws about %2$s chips.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.brace.on: Two-arm form: both arms/pincers press down at once - the press radius is x1.7 and the shove x1.25, covering several foes standing together; in exchange the single-target power is x0.86, the wind-up +2 ticks and the cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.brace.off: One-arm form (default): a focused press, heavier on a single target and quicker to throw, but it only holds one foe.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.timing: Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cost %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.growth.0: From level %1$s: press power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.growth.1: From level %1$s: press power rises to %2$s and the press radius widens to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.use.0: Open a fight with the heaviest press on a full-HP target
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.use.1: Pin several clustered foes with the two-arm form
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.use.2: Keep pressing with the fastest cycle of the three
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.preference.b: On: both arms/pincers press at once, radius x1.7 and shove x1.25, covering several clustered foes, but single-target power x0.86, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off: one-arm form, heavier and faster on one target.
worldcombat.skill.hardpress.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in before pressing. Larger values press from further out and get walked away from during the raise more often.
On: sort targets by remaining HP fraction, full-HP foes first (the press is heaviest on them). Off: only the threat itself counts, so it will press wounded foes too.
world_combat.move.hardpress.text.miss: Hard Press found nothing to press
